STEP 5. Check the harness wires between rear wiper 
motor connector F-07 and ignition switch (ACC).
NOTE: After checking intermediate connector F-24 and 
junction block connectors C-101 and C-113, check the wires. If 
intermediate connector F-24 and junction block connectors C-
101 and C-113 are damaged, repair or replace them. Refer to 
GROUP 00E, Harness Connector Inspection P.00E-2.
Q: Are the harness wires between rear wiper motor 
connector F-07 and ignition switch (ACC) in good 
condition?
YES : There is no action to be taken.
NO : Repair them. The rear wiper motor auto-stop signal 
should be able to be checked and the rear wiper 
should stop at the predetermined park position.
